included: Batch all 13 model-normal sampler states through the existing known-only mirror; exact old GetSamplerState fallback on unknown/inactive state or untrusted context.
Snapshot hash-prefix reuse, source-identity envelope reuse, immutable geometry residency, range proofs and prepared pose evaluation CPU optimizations.
SSE2 skin-envelope interval evaluation with bit-identical bounds, unchanged stop cadence and outward rounding.
Bounded dynamic buffer range mirrors reduce synchronous relocks without retaining undefined/stale bytes.
Native lamp shadow ownership patch and MPQ light deduplication; native sources remain when present, additions only when absent.
Shared base/composition neutral-input work reduction, capture admission and state reuse, shader variants and source-linked regression coverage.

earlier_cpu_measurements.note: Separate local CPU microbenchmarks against each iteration's frozen input. Percentages are not additive and are not game FPS.
